portfolio_role.summary: Measure and pressure responses under declared constraints, maintain falsifiable measurement candidates and evidence states, and consume exact upstream gonol representations without treating representation as measurement validity or silently inserting token, subword, or opaque-vector layers.
portfolio_role.upstream_contract: EDCM consumes exact source evidence, declared semantic constraints where used, and pinned UCNS structural candidates, profiles, or future source-bound gonol receipts without inheriting their authority. The current language path is Unicode character gonols -> fixed floor word gonols -> closed lexical floor -> floor-definition gonols; UCNS owns that construction.
portfolio_role.downstream_contract: EDCM emits measurement artifacts, experiment findings, receipts, and explicit evidence statuses that downstream systems may consume without upgrading them.

reports_to.relation: repo-owned measurement-plan and evidence-status input; no authority transfer

status.current_claim: EDCM supports represented, candidate-measured, and experiment-supported evidence in declared scopes; canon_selection remains null and empirical validation is not established. For language, EDCM is a downstream consumer of a gonol-native UCNS path: Unicode character gonols are primitive inscription objects, floor word gonols form a closed lexical floor, and semantic floor definitions must be gonols composed only from existing floor gonols. Existing arbitrary definition text and historical token/profile surfaces are not the completed semantic representation.
